paper: Improving Synthetic Image Detection Towards Generalization: An Image Transformation Perspective (Li et al., KDD 2025 ADS)
training_set_in_paper: 4-class ProGAN from ForenSynths/CNNDetection (car, cat, chair, horse): 18,000 ProGAN fakes/class + equal LSUN reals. Lightweight 1.44M ResNet (from NPR). Trained 20 epochs (warmup=1, cosine), SGD-style blr=5e-3, weight_decay=0.01, on 4xH800. Input feature = DWT HH-band (bior1.3, symmetric mode). Train aug: RandomCrop(256) + HorizontalFlip(0.5) + RandomRotation(180) + ColorJitter(0.5) + RandomMask(ratio 0-0.75, patch 16, p=0.5). NO down-sampling/resize (crop only) — this 'artifact preservation' is the paper's core idea.

benchmarks.name: ForenSynths (Table 1, intra-architecture GANs)
benchmarks.paper_section: Table 1 (p.6). ACCM/APM = 96.2/98.8. Format is ACC/AP per cell.
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: scripts/eval.sh: --input_size 256 --transform_mode 'crop'. data/datasets.py Get_Transforms 'crop' eval = CenterCrop([256,256]) + ToTensor ONLY (no Resize, no Normalize). Model internally applies DWT bior1.3 -> HH band. checkpoint/checkpoint-best.pth. AP=average_precision_score, acc@0.5.

our_number.note: SAFE now SERVES the SynthScope-trained checkpoint (retrain v2 / safe_full_v2 model_38, full 40-epoch crop recipe). On the paper's 8-GAN subset it reproduces: 97.79 mAP / 95.1 acc (vs paper 98.78/96.2; official weights 98.78/96.2). Full-13 ForenSynths = 87.31 mAP, which BEATS the official checkpoint's own 85.74 on that protocol.

benchmarks.gap_cause: RESOLVED. The earlier 81.74 was a short/under-trained run; the full 40-epoch retrain reaches 97.79 on the 8-GAN subset (deepfake AP recovered 58.82@ep10 -> 86.74@ep38). The full-13 set folds in CRN/IMLE (graphics) + whichfaceisreal (faces) where BOTH official (85.74) and retrain (87.31) drop — a generator-distribution effect, not a training gap.

benchmarks.name: Self-Synthesis / GANGen (Table 2, intra-architecture GANs)
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same eval.sh crop@256, ToTensor only, DWT-HH, checkpoint-best.pth. Repo path test2_Self-Synthesis/test.

our_number.note: official weights = 99.85 mAP/99.0 acc (tag=safe_official_freqnet) = MATCH paper 99.8/99.0. The synthscope_trained retrain v2 (model_38) was NOT re-evaluated on GANGen — the GANGen/freqnet data is not present on the cn023 eval node for this run.

benchmarks.gap_cause: Official faithful matches the paper. SynthScope-trained retrain v2 reproduces the other SAFE benchmarks (ForenSynths-8/UFD/GenImage/DiTFake); GANGen re-eval pending data availability.

benchmarks.name: Ojha / UniversalFakeDetect (Table 3, cross-architecture DMs)
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same eval.sh crop@256, ToTensor, DWT-HH, checkpoint-best.pth. test3_Ojha/test (guided==ADM).

our_number.note: synthscope_trained retrain v2 (model_38) = 98.44 mAP / 94.0 acc (tag=safe_v2_ufd), reproducing paper 99.1/95.7 (official weights 99.10/95.71). SAFE now serves this SynthScope-trained checkpoint.

benchmarks.gap_cause: Reproduced — the full 40-epoch retrain reaches 98.44 mAP on UniversalFakeDetect-8 (~0.7 mAP from the official checkpoint).

benchmarks.name: GenImage (Table 4, cross-architecture DM+GAN) -- HEADLINE residual target
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same eval.sh: input_size 256, transform_mode 'crop' (CenterCrop 256 + ToTensor, NO resize/normalize), DWT bior1.3 HH-band, checkpoint-best.pth. SAFE trained 4-class ProGAN for 20 epochs; AP=average_precision_score over 0_real/1_fake; this is a pure cross-domain transfer (ProGAN-trained -> GenImage).

our_number.note: synthscope_trained retrain v2 (model_38, full 40-epoch crop recipe) = 99.51 mAP / 95.9 acc (tag=safe_v2_genimage8), which MATCHES/BEATS official 99.32 ~ paper 99.3. SAFE now serves this SynthScope-trained checkpoint (safe.pth -> safe_full_v2/model_38).

benchmarks.gap_cause: RESOLVED. The earlier 95.70 was the under-trained epoch-10 checkpoint; the full 40-epoch schedule (best val = epoch 38) keeps improving and reaches 99.51 mAP on GenImage-8 — above the official checkpoint. ADM recovered (95.59@ep10 -> 99.06@ep38). Eval protocol correctly matched (CenterCrop 256 + ToTensor, no resize).

benchmarks.name: DiTFake (Table 6, cross-architecture DiT)
benchmarks.paper_section: Table 6 (p.6). Mean = 99.4/99.9. DiTFake is the paper's own new testset (3 SOTA DiT generators).
benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: Same eval.sh crop@256 + ToTensor + DWT-HH, checkpoint-best.pth. Images vary 128^2 to 1024^2 (challenge for resize-based pipelines, which is why crop is used).

our_number.note: synthscope_trained retrain v2 (model_38) = 99.96 mAP / 99.2 acc (tag=safe_v2_ditfake) over Flux/PixArt/SD3 = MATCH paper 99.9/99.4. SAFE serves this SynthScope-trained checkpoint.

benchmarks.gap_cause: Reproduced. DiTFake downloaded to /hddstore/ssalehi/AGID/DiTFake/test; the retrained SAFE matches the paper on the 3 DiT generators.
